Character · Fully private live-aboard · Nubian fishing guides and crew · 4×4 desert day · cabin or deck sleeping
Character · Fully private live-aboard · Nubian fishing guides and crew · 4×4 desert day · cabin or deck sleeping
Dinner is on board as the desert behind the eastern shore turns dark.

The morning bite — early, before the wind picks up — is for serious fishing; midday, the boat drops into a quiet cove for a swim from the deck and a casual lunch the crew cooks aboard; the afternoon goes back to fishing or shifts to a kayak excursion into the smaller inlets the mother ship cannot enter.
